pasos.detalle: Hi! I'm Sunny from Brightside. How can I help?

Hello, I am Sunny, the virtual assistant for Brightside Outdoor. You can return any unused item within 45 days of delivery for a full refund, provided items are clean, unworn, and in their original packaging with tags attached. Final sale items, gift cards, and personalized products cannot be returned, and returns are free with a prepaid label. Is there anything else you need help with?

— The Brightside team
If that email is linked to a purchase, you'll receive a 6-digit code. Type it here to confirm you're the account holder. It expires in 10 minutes.

All set, you're verified! Hello, I am Sunny, the virtual assistant for Brightside Outdoor. Your order NW-4521 shipped with UPS Ground under tracking number 1Z9A4F210377451236.

Unfortunately, there is a delay due to a weather delay at the carrier's Denver hub, so it is now expected to arrive on November 26, 2026. I am very sorry for the inconvenience this may cause.

Since your order is arriving later than expected, would you like a 10% off coupon for your next order or free express shipping? Is there anything else I can help with?
